subject: PO fields, holdback language & quarterly invoice cadence — HealthSecure
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@healthsecure.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthsecure.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 13:07:00 -0400
Subject: PO fields and invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the demo last week — team is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to confirm a few details so we can issue a Purchase Order that maps cleanly into our ERP:

- PO must include: Redwood legal entity name + EIN, Redwood billing contact, and a single master PO reference number.
- Invoice cadence: HealthSecure prefers quarterly invoices tied to consumption thresholds (we're proposing quarter-end billing).
- Net terms: standard is Net45 for us; if Redwood requires Net30 we need that flagged to finance.
- Holdback: our legal team typically holds 5% for 60 days on first invoices for new vendors. Is Redwood willing to accept a 5% holdback on the initial quarter?

Attached is our vendor PO template (PDF). Can you confirm what fields you need from us so the PO can be generated without rework? Also, any constraints we should flag to our accounts payable team?

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement would like to issue the PO by Wed 6/30.

Best,
Ayesha Khan
Sr. Procurement Manager
HealthSecure Inc.

Attachment: HealthSecure_PO_Template.pdf (stub)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@healthsecure.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields and invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Ayesha — thanks, and glad the demo was helpful. Short answers up front: we can support the PO fields you listed and quarterly invoicing; the holdback is negotiable with a small modification. Details below.

What we need on the PO (minimum):
- Redwood Inference, Inc. (Legal name)
- Redwood EIN: 12-3456789
- Billing contact: Billing Ops <billing@redwood.ai>
- Master PO number / reference (custom field accepted)

Invoice cadence options (we can do either):
- Quarterly fixed billing: Redwood issues one invoice at quarter close for total consumption during the quarter.
- Monthly interim invoices with quarterly true-up: we invoice monthly for estimated usage, then one quarter-end true-up invoice.

Holdback options:
- We can accept a 5% holdback on the initial quarter total, provided Redwood can net that against the quarter-end true-up (i.e., holdback released after 60 days post-invoice).
- Alternative: accept holdback but discount the first invoice by 2% to offset early payment risk.

Net terms: our standard hosted customers are Net30; we can offer Net45 for enterprise customers in exchange for a 3% annual committed-usage discount or a one-quarter prepay. If HealthSecure needs Net45 without commitment, we'd ask for a short commercial exception.

I attached a Redwood PO template (PDF) and a quick pricing breakdown (XLSX) with the committed-discount math. If you prefer, I can loop in Vivek for executive approval of the holdback concession.

Next steps: if Procurement can share the draft PO today, I will review and return any redlines within 24 hours so you can issue by Wed.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.pdf, pricing-breakdown-q3.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@healthsecure.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields and invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Ayesha / Maya — quick note from finance: we can accept a 5% holdback for the first quarter with these constraints so it doesn't impact our month-end cash forecasting:

- Holdback only applies to one invoice cycle (initial quarter).
- Release after 60 days post-invoice with no additional verification unless there is a dispute.
- HealthSecure must reference the Redwood invoice number and PO number in the payment remittance advice.

Regarding Net terms: we will accept Net45 for this customer if they sign a 12-month commitment at the 3% committed-usage discount tier. If HealthSecure prefers no commitment, terms revert to Net30.

From a billing operations perspective, the cleanest approach is: monthly interim invoices + quarter-end true-up with a single quarter-end invoice that includes the holdback line item. That keeps AR reconciliations straightforward for both sides.

If that works, Maya can approve the revised commercial terms and we'll prepare the contract redlines today.

—Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: billing-guidance-onepager.pdf (stub)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.khan@healthsecure.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthsecure.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO fields and invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Maya / Vivek — thanks, that is helpful and aligns with our internal policy. Procurement will issue the PO this afternoon with these notes:

- Master PO number included
- Invoice cadence: monthly interim invoices + quarter-end true-up (we'll accept the single quarter-end invoice with holdback line item)
- Initial holdback: 5% for 60 days on first quarter only; reference invoice/PO numbers in remittance
- Net terms: HealthSecure will sign a 12-month commitment to qualify for Net45 @ 3% discount.

We'll send the signed PO and the vendor onboarding packet to billing@redwood.ai in the next hour. Looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Ayesha
Sr. Procurement Manager
HealthSecure Inc.
